verdict.rationale: Alloy is an identity and fraud-decisioning SaaS platform with an SDK, so whether users can opt out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out, for either the platform or the SDK. The event-storage, monitoring and health-signal docs cover processing of customer-submitted data and service status, not product telemetry controls.
